first_public_date_evidence: arXiv:2301.07943v1 dated 19 January 2023; the 2023 journal date is not used as first public date.
scientific_integrity: Analytic proof for real finite measure and positive nonatomic component; exact-rational finite checker is non-certifying; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only scalar real L1, finite total mass, positive nonatomic component. Purely atomic case has no nonzero weakly-null norm, and vector-valued extensions are not asserted.
title: Sharp weakly-null almost-square profiles in mixed real \(L^1\) spaces
